To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
PerOpteryx systematically optimizes software architectures based on quality requirements.

PerOpteryx systematically optimizes the quality of software architectures with regard to several quality requirements, such as performance and reliability, and is the first automated software architecture optimization tool that combines quantitively and qualitively modeled knowledge.
PerOpteryx systematically evaluates and optimizes software architectures with regard to quality requirements of the system.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following questions: (1) Which architecture candidates exist for a given software system? (2) Which architecture candidate is best suited for the software system with regard to the requirements of the system?
the development of a tool that automatically evaluates and improves software architectures with regard to quality characteristics.
the development of a tool-supported method for systematic optimization of component based architecture models with regard to quality requirements.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
PerOpteryx enables systematic quality-oriented optimization of component based architectures.
the PerOpteryx approach is the most comprehensive and detailed approach to the automated optimization of component based architectures with regard to the most important software quality requirements.
PerOpteryx can be used to optimize the architecture of software systems with regard to several quality attributes in early design phases.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a tool that supports the systematic process for the quality optimization of component-based software architectures.
we developed a systematic process for the evaluation and optimization of software architecture models early.
PerOpteryx systematically supports the quality-oriented development of component based software systems by automatically evaluating and optimizing software architectures.

automated architecture optimization can be achieved in a systematic and reliable way, and can be applied to large software systems.
